_comment: Examples under datrix/examples/ that the REAL generation pipeline cannot build today.
This is a DELIBERATELY MAINTAINED SCOPE BOUNDARY, not an auto-heal: it converts a genuine,
pre-existing generation FAILURE into a loudly-reported skip in the reference-example parity
gate (datrix/scripts/test/reference-example-parity-gate.ps1). It never hides output drift --
a listed (example, language) pair that does generate is still hash-compared against its baseline.
KEY FORMAT (language sweep): a bare example_id applies to every registered
language the gate sweeps -- for a failure at config-resolution/deployment-plan-building time,
before any language-specific codegen stage runs (the original two entries below). An
'example_id::language' key applies to that one language only -- for a defect in one language's
own codegen stage while the same example generates fine in every other registered language
(a distinction that could not exist before the language sweep made every example genuinely
All entries reproduce with the sanctioned generator (generate.ps1 <system.dtrx> <out> -L <language>),
so none is a gate artifact.
expected_count is a pinned, reviewed value: change it only in the same change that adds or
removes an entry. Removing an entry means the defect is FIXED and the example must be blessed.

examples.02-features-02-service-architecture-pubs: ConfigResolutionError ING001: the system declares a gateway {} block but no service derives ServiceIngressExposure.GATEWAY (a front door with nothing behind it). Example-definition defect: the example declares no external-caller auth(...) endpoint. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-REPLAYABLE-INGESTION-ING001.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-con: ValueError from build_runtime_bootstrap: RuntimeBootstrap LOCAL requires config_store engine 'file' (platform 'container'), but the example declares engine='consul' platform='container'. The example's declared config store is incompatible with the LOCAL runtime-bootstrap contract. Unregistered in test-projects.json, so generate.ps1 -All never built it. Follow-up: FIX-EXAMPLE-CONFIG-STORE-CONSUL-BOOTSTRAP.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-nos: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes landed): mvnw compile fails on 3 services. library_book_service: a DSL Array.filter(lambda) call on a query result transpiles to a literal '.filter(...)' call on java.util.List (needs Stream API lowering), the API-level fn 'findBooksByFilter' (-> Array<bookDb.Book>) infers the wrong Java return type (List<UUID> instead of List<Book>), and a custom endpoint returning a CQRS view list has the same DTO-mapping gap named below. library_loan_service: the cross-service internal-API call syntax (ServiceName.APIName.verb.endpoint(...)) never wires its target service as a constructor-injected client -- datrix-codegen-java's own TranspileContext.service_name_map (the slot python's plugin.py populates for exactly this) is declared but never populated for java (grep-confirmed: two definition sites, zero real writers/readers); same gap also leaves DateTime.addDays(...) untranslated and drops an unrelated logger field. library_member_service: MemberProfile (a struct) built from a raw Map, and a Member->MemberResponse generic-bounds mismatch. Every remaining service ALSO hits the custom-endpoint entity-to-Response-DTO mapping gap (return book; where the signature declares BookResponse) -- tracked separately, see queue::java's entry. datrix-codegen-java gaps; out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CROSS-SERVICE-CLIENT-INJECTION.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-que: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes landed): mvnw compile fails only on the entity-to-Response-DTO mapping gap -- a hand-authored (non-CRUD) endpoint body that 'return's an entity/entity-list value, where the endpoint's declared return type is that entity's generated {Entity}Response DTO, is transpiled with no mapping at all (return book; against a BookResponse-returning method; return bookRepository.findAll(spec); against a List<BookResponse>-returning method). The CRUD-generated endpoints already build this correctly via build_response_mapping_expr (_endpoint_crud.py); the DSL-authored-body path (transpile_custom_body/visit_return) never threads that same context through. datrix-codegen-java gap; out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CUSTOM-ENDPOINT-ENTITY-RESPONSE-MAPPING.
examples.02-features-03-infrastructure-blocks-cac: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes landed): mvnw compile fails on the SAME two gaps as nosql::java -- the missing cross-service internal-API client injection (service_name_map never populated for java) in LoanAPIController/MemberAPIController, plus DateTime.addDays(...) emitted untranslated and the custom-endpoint entity-to-Response-DTO mapping gap (see queue::java's entry) in BookServiceAPIController. datrix-codegen-java gaps; out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CROSS-SERVICE-CLIENT-INJECTION.
examples.02-features-02-service-architecture-pubs: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes landed): mvnw compile fails on 2 services. library_book_service: the entity-to-Response-DTO mapping gap (see queue::java's entry) PLUS the Book entity's own computed-field methods fail to compile independently of any controller -- an Array<String> field's DSL methods (.length(), .join(', ')) transpile to java.util.List<String> method calls that do not exist (needs .size()/String.join(', ', list)), a String[]-vs-List<String> field-init mismatch, and Math.round(a_BigDecimal_field, precision) has no matching java.lang.Math overload (needs BigDecimal-aware rounding). library_member_service: MemberProfile built from a raw Map, plus the Member->MemberResponse generic-bounds mismatch (same as nosql::java's member service). datrix-codegen-java gaps (computed-field collection/BigDecimal builtin translation, entity-to-DTO mapping, struct construction); out of this data-blessing task's scope. Follow-up: FIX-JAVA-CUSTOM-ENDPOINT-ENTITY-RESPONSE-MAPPING.
examples.02-features-04-extensions-geo::java: Verified 2026-08-01 (after this sweep's own repository-injection/record-accessor fixes landed): mvnw compile fails only on the entity-to-Response-DTO mapping gap (see queue::java's entry) -- both a single-Warehouse return and List<Warehouse>/List<DeliveryZone> returns from hand-authored endpoint bodies against WarehouseResponse/DeliveryZoneResponse-declared signatures. The original park reason (an unresolved 'all(...)' entity-query construct) is fixed -- this sweep's where-chain repository-import fix (_entity_query_where_chain.py) was what unblocked generation far enough to reach this new, later-stage failure. datrix-codegen-java gap; out of this data-blessing task's scope.
